summary: Completed focused testing of Anjhelika AI girlfriend/assistant app new features. All UI components, animated avatar mood system, wake word detection, and conversation sidebar are working correctly. Backend APIs functional except for expected Ollama connectivity issue.

expected_failures.issue: Returns 520 error when trying to connect to Ollama
expected_failures.impact: Chat functionality unavailable without local Ollama
expected_failures.fix_priority: EXPECTED - Ollama not available in cloud environment

passed_tests: Homepage loads with animated SVG avatar showing mood indicator
Avatar mood system works - mood changed from 'neutral' to 'concerned'
Menu button opens conversation sidebar successfully
Sidebar shows 'Conversations' header and 'New Chat' button
Wake word toggle button works - changes state and shows neon styling
Wake word status indicator appears when enabled
Voice orb is visible and clickable with purple neon styling
Text input field accepts input and works correctly
Message sending UI flow works (transitions from idle to chat state)
Control bar shows all required buttons (mic, volume, trash, settings)
Settings panel opens when settings button clicked
Dark cyberpunk theme applied correctly with proper background
Error handling works - shows toast for Ollama disconnection
Avatar SVG has complex structure with 19 elements
UI state transitions work properly between idle and chat modes
